issue_request: FHIR-6209 was a Published FHIR-core Device change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking for documentation to clarify that non-medical devices such as communication devices, cell phones, and computers may be represented with Device.
initial_application: No explicit git commit mentioning FHIR-6209 was found. The migrated Device StructureDefinition has a committee note for 6209 on the Device root and a root definition stating that a Device may be medical or non-medical. Later Device narrative work added examples of non-medical devices to device-introduction.xml.
additional_context: Device is active in source/fhir.ini. Later OO Device scope/boundary issues FHIR-24936 and FHIR-23768 revised related Device descriptions, but the current Device introduction, root definition, and Device module page preserve the non-medical and software/virtual device scope. Searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence that conflicts with this conclusion.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build-scope Device source already conveys the approved clarification in both conformance and narrative surfaces.
